description_en: Queries the configuration of a production studio
kebab_example: aliyun live describe-caster-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --caster-id LIVEPRODUCER_POST-cn-0pp1czt0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCasterConfig

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the production studio.

- If you create the production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html operation, use the CasterId value that is returned in the response.

- If you create the production studio in the console, go to the **LIVE console** > **Production Studio** > **Cloud Production Studio** page to view the ID.

> The name of the production studio in the list on the Cloud Production Studio page is the production studio ID
parameters.help_zh:
导播台ID。

- 如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html接口创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

- 如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过**直播控制台** > **导播台** > **云导播台**页面查看。

> 直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID
parameters.name: caster_id
